messages:
Ana: Quick update — ran canary for the new 'meteor-prefetch' heuristic combined with the twin-slab batcher. Early numbers look solid: p50 latency -18%, p99 -12%, token cost -29% on our conversational eval. Rolling to 10% tomorrow.

Chris: Nice! Which models and seq lengths did you run? baseline for comparison?

Ana: Tests used rdl-7b-q4 (our quantized 7B), seq=1024 typical chat mix (assistant + multi-turn conv). Baseline was current stable packer+kv with same HW. Canary workload = 70/30 read/write pattern with realistic prefix reuse.

Jia: Any cold-start or tail regressions? KV hit-rate change?

Ana: Cold-starts: +5ms median on first token (expected due to an extra prefetch probe), but steady-state wins justify it. KV hit rate improved ~42% for assistant traces (prefetch fills hot slots). No p99 regressions on cold path observed in the canary.

Chris: Mind dropping the raw bench snippet?

Ana: Sure — raw canary vs baseline (averages across 12 runs):
```
metric               baseline    canary      delta
----------------------------------------------
p50 latency (ms)     98.4        80.6        -17.9%
p99 latency (ms)     412         362         -12.1%
avg tokens/sec       1250        1610        +28.8%
unit token cost ($)  0.00174     0.00124     -28.7%
kv cache hit (%)     31.2        44.3        +42.0%
cold-start p50 (ms)  24.1        29.0        +20.3%
```

Sam: Deployed canary to 10% traffic in us-west pool around 09:20 PT. No error rate uptick, CPU/GPU utilization steady. Observed cost drop in the dev namespace billing view already. :party-parrot:

infra-bot: Deployment canary started — meteor-prefetch-v2 on pool-us-west-3 (canary 10%). Links: https://console.redwood.internal/deploys/meteor-prefetch-v2

Jia: Good call to restrict cold-start hit — +5ms is fine, but keep an eye on tiny inference clients (mobile/web). Any plan to gate by request size?

Ana: Yes — rollout plan: enable heuristic only for requests with prefix_len >= 32 and seq <= 2048 for first 48h. Mobile/web teams will be excluded in initial phase.

Matthew: Awesome improvement. Let's schedule flip to 100% after 48h if no regressions and then promote to Dedicated pools next week. Can you open a short rollout PR with checks/metrics to watch? I'll own the Dedicated rollout coordination.

Ana: Will open PR in infra/playbooks with the metric dashboard links, canary thresholds, and rollback steps. Also adding a short note to the CHANGELOG and release notes for 2.4.1.

Chris: Couple of yaks to shave later: consider a micro-tune for tiny-batches to reclaim that +5ms cold-start penalty, and add a small backoff for prefetch on low-confidence prefixes.

Sam: Agree. I'll add a quick alert that fires if cold-start p50 > 60ms or kv-hit drops below 25% in canary.

Ana: Thanks everyone. Cutting a short postmortem + bench writeup after 48h. For now: big win on steady-state latency & cost. :tada:
